provenance.notes: Templates come from the IEEE Template Selector. The class option [journal] and the layout are NOT stated on the pages checked: confirm them in IEEEtran_HOWTO.pdf and in your journal's author instructions, which may add rules (length, review format).

limits.text: Set by the journal. Check its author instructions.

facts.text: IEEE provides templates through the IEEE Template Selector.
IEEEtran supports IEEE transactions and journals (CTAN, v1.8b, LPPL 1.3).
Class option [journal], US Letter, two columns, Times 10 pt.

compile_check.tool: tectonic 0.17.0 (TeX bundle with the real class file)
compile_check.result: The generated main.tex compiled without errors on a real 15-page paper and rendered in two columns. This shows the class name and option are accepted; it does not show that the venue accepts the result.
